Specification: This module is a small regression-style TLA+ specification that tests function application, tuple indexing, record field access by string key, and function override behavior. It uses TLC operators such as Assert and Print inside an invariant-like state predicate to check that various applications and EXCEPT updates evaluate to the expected values. The system itself has only one state variable x, initialized to 1 and left unchanged forever, so the main purpose of the spec is expression evaluation rather than modeling a distributed algorithm or fault-tolerant protocol.
